RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel's gender without concrete evidence will harm your professional reputation. For a department head, selection committees routinely prioritize broad leadership experience and formal management training over advanced academic degrees like a PhD. The appointed candidate’s qualifications directly align with executive demands. 

Additionally, biomedical science and healthcare management have high female representation; an all-women panel is common and not evidence of bias. A two-week wait for written feedback is also typical for hospital HR timelines. 

Instead of alleging discrimination, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on specific leadership competencies you can develop for future executive roles.
